findings: D1 Transport (`lsp-server-0.10.0-Message-read-write`): In `public-dependencies/source/lsp-server-0.10.0/src/msg.rs`, `Message::read(&mut impl BufRead) -> io::Result<Option<Message>>` and `Message::write(&self, &mut impl Write) -> io::Result<()>` (along with `Message::{Request, Response, Notification}`, `RequestId`, `ResponseError`, and `ErrorCode::{ServerNotInitialized, InvalidRequest, InvalidParams, MethodNotFound}`) are public and directly support a synchronous single-threaded dispatch loop on locked `stdin`/`stdout`. This avoids the 3 OS threads (`LspServerWriter`, `LspMessageDropper`, `LspServerReader`) and zero-capacity `crossbeam_channel::bounded(0)` queues spawned by `Connection::stdio()` (`lsp-server-0.10.0/src/stdio.rs` lines 13-54) as well as the 1s/30s `recv_timeout` loops in `Connection::initialize_start_while` and `Connection::handle_shutdown` (`lsp-server-0.10.0/src/lib.rs` lines 157, 354), while avoiding bespoke `Content-Length` header framing over `serde_json`.

D2 Types (`gen-lsp-types-0.11.0-no-features-3.17-subset`): Aliasing `gen-lsp-types = "=0.11.0"` as `lsp-types` with `default-features = false` (`public-dependencies/source/gen-lsp-types-0.11.0/Cargo.toml`) disables `url` and `fluent-uri`, leaving only `serde` and `serde_json` as dependencies and compiling `Uri` (`src/generated/common.rs` lines 25-64) as a transparent `pub struct Uri(pub String)` wrapper that matches the in-memory opaque document URI rule. Although generated from the LSP 3.18 metamodel, restricting output to the specified LSP 3.17 subset is exact: `Diagnostic.message` (`src/generated/structures.rs` line 6295) uses `#[serde(untagged)] pub enum Message { String(String), MarkupContent(MarkupContent) }` (`src/generated/enum_ors.rs` lines 1184-1187), so constructing `Message::String` serializes as a plain JSON string without requiring 3.18 `markupMessageSupport`. By contrast, `lsp-types-0.97.0` (`public-dependencies/source/lsp-types-0.97.0/Cargo.toml`) pulls in `bitflags = "1.0.1"` (alongside existing `source/Cargo.lock` `bitflags 2.13.2`), `fluent-uri = "0.1.4"`, and `serde_repr = "0.1"`.
